errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis omits the units "(in 1.000)", which are explicitly stated in the axis label "Zahl Entlastete (in 1.000)". While the first sentence mentions the units, the specific description of the axis label is incomplete and thus inaccurate.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet, basierend auf dem untersten Wert jeder Einkommensspanne.
errors.evidence: This sentence describes the obvious ordering of the x-axis categories, which is standard for histogram-like charts with binned numerical data. It adds little value and makes the description unnecessarily long.
